caption: A thick garden hose is cut through with a pair of shears, leaving two open ends.

sa.check: A garden hose and a pair of shears are present.
The shears cut through the hose.
The cut comes first and the two ends follow.

pc.expect: The hose is severed where the blades close and only there, after they meet.
pc.fail: It is cut elsewhere; or it is cut before the blades meet; or the blades close and the hose stays whole.

pc.expect: The hose pinches under the blades before severing, leaving rubber ends.
pc.fail: It shatters; or the blades bend; or the hose stretches.
They rejoin; or a third piece appears; or the hose is whole again.
They float; or rise; or hang.

pc.expect: One hose becomes two, and one pair of shears keeps its number.
pc.fail: The shears pass through the hand; or a second hose appears; or the shears vanish.

pc.expect: The hose's colour and the shears stay the same.
pc.fail: The hose changes colour; or the shears change; or the garden rearranges.
